scriptOverride.reason: Uses a 'then' chained follow-up (a delayedEffect with its own nested when: onConflictFinished) to return the resurrected character to the bottom of its deck if it's still in play at the end of the conflict - neither 'then' chaining nor delayedEffect's nested when are modeled by the schema, and omitting the follow-up would materially change the card's balance (a permanent resurrection instead of a temporary one).
